title: Arkret Call Signal Plaintext
description: Closed top-level plaintext object carried inside a SignalEnvelope encrypted_payload for ak.call.signal. The signal_kind-specific data object is validated by the corresponding normative branch in zh/crypto-media/webrtc-signaling.md.

payload_sequence.description: Strictly increasing but non-contiguous u64 within (sender_device_id, canonical scope_ref); arbitrary forward gaps are accepted. It is independent of seq, the per-call anti-rollback sequence monotonic over (realm_id, call_id, actor_id, device_id).

data.description: Signal-kind-specific payload. Producers and consumers MUST additionally validate the closed field rules for the selected signal_kind in webrtc-signaling.md; this extension point is encrypted end-to-end and is not interpreted by the Signal service.
